sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 375)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, Canadian CBC broadcasting, and syndication, Richard Thorne's sci-fi fungal horror *The Brown Plague* on *The Hall of Fantasy* (1952), Robert Louis Stevenson's *The Body Snatchers* on CBC's *Nightfall* (1980), Lon Clark solving *The Case of the Crimson Clue* on *Nick Carter, Master Detective* (1954), Douglas Edwards reporting on Nazi martial law in Denmark on *CBS World News Today* (1943), Freddie Rich leading *Your Hit Parade* for Lucky Strike (1936), and wartime investigative journalism on *Troman Harper, Rumor Detective* (1936–1980):
